## Change

Describe the resulting behaviour and any material limitations.

## Version

- Previous -> new `package.json` version:
- Category and reason: patch (fix/maintenance), minor (capability/tax-year support), major (breaking change), or exempt (docs/tests/CI only).
- `bun run check-version --base origin/main` result after fetching current `main`:

## Verification

Commands, pass/fail results and reviewable evidence (dated report or attached artifacts).
Distinguish local checks from preview and production verification.

Independent review is required before merge. Merge, deployment and tag publication each need explicit maintainer approval.
